title: Per-agent launch command overrides in osf.toml
summary: Adds an `[agents.launch.<name>]` table to `osf.toml` so an adopter can replace an agent's launch command and add non-secret environment without forking osf. `agents::resolve` validates each override (known agent, enabled, non-empty command, no provider credential variable in any letter case) and stores it on `Selection`; `reviewers::roster` threads it into `Reviewer.command` and `Reviewer.env`, and `prepare_command` applies the template env first so the fresh `RunHome` and allow-listed variables still win. The doctor message and development docs are reworded to drop the stale launch-templates note.

nodes.label: osf.toml
nodes.subtitle: [agents.launch.<name>]
nodes.summary: The repository config file. This change gives it a new `[agents.launch.<name>]` table holding `command` and `env` per agent.

nodes.label: AgentsConfig
nodes.subtitle: config.rs
nodes.summary: Deserialized `[agents]` table. Gains a `launch` map and the new `LaunchTemplateConfig` struct with `command` and `env`, both `deny_unknown_fields` and defaulted.

nodes.label: AGENTS list
nodes.subtitle: agents.rs
nodes.summary: The static list of every agent osf can drive. Gains `KNOWN_CREDENTIAL_VARS`, the provider credential aliases a launch template may never carry.

nodes.label: agents::resolve
nodes.subtitle: Selection
nodes.summary: Validates the config against the agent list. Now also builds the credential-name set, then for each launch override checks the agent is known and enabled, the command is non-empty, and no env key is a credential variable in any letter case; stores the result as `LaunchTemplate` on `Selection`.

nodes.label: Selection
nodes.subtitle: enabled, reviewers, models, launch
nodes.summary: The resolved view of `[agents]`. Gains a `launch` map and a `launch(agent)` accessor returning the `LaunchTemplate` override, if any.

nodes.label: reviewers::roster
nodes.subtitle: Vec<Reviewer>
nodes.summary: Builds the reviewer list from the selection. Now passes `selection.launch(agent)` into `Reviewer::from_agent`.

nodes.label: Reviewer::from_agent
nodes.subtitle: command, env
nodes.summary: Takes an optional `LaunchTemplate`. When present it replaces the agent's own command and supplies `env`; otherwise the built-in command is used and `env` is empty. Read-only mode, schema flag and model flag still come from the agent entry.

nodes.label: Reviewer
nodes.subtitle: command, env, read_only
nodes.summary: The per-agent run description. Gains an `env` field carrying the template environment.

nodes.label: prepare_command
nodes.subtitle: Command
nodes.summary: Builds the child `Command` with a cleared environment. Now applies the reviewer's template env first, then the fresh `RunHome`, then the read-only and clean-copy variables, so the fresh home and allow-listed variables always take precedence.

nodes.label: doctor binaries check
nodes.subtitle: agent-binaries
nodes.summary: The `agent-binaries` check message is reworded: the unknown status now points at the unimplemented agent version pin rather than the launch templates.

nodes.label: Agent binary
nodes.subtitle: spawned child
nodes.summary: The external agent program osf launches to review. It receives the template command, the template env, the fresh home and the allow-listed variables.
